description: I just filed over 400 certified signatures for my State Senate run at the Massachusetts State House, one month ahead of the filing deadline.Not everything went perfectly - 30 signatures couldn’t be counted due to a missing municipal stamp - but even then, we cleared the requirement by more than 100.This campaign is being built the hard way: one conversation at a time. No party backing. Low budget. But real support from people across the district has made this possible.And we’re just getting star
title: Certified Signatures Filed With the State One Month Ahead of the Deadline
